subject: Save the Whole output of shinyStan

messages.author: 23108129612298d3
messages.subject: Save the Whole output of shinyStan
parts:
Dear rstan and shinyStan users;
Can I save the entire output of shinyStan to open in other device? For example by an IE? 
When I click on save&exit not found the destination of the saving!
I'm user of the Windows 10.
Thanks 
Mahdi

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Save the Whole output of shinyStan
parts:
Hi Mahdi, 

There are several possibilities: 

1) Create a shinystan object (sso) from your stanfit object using the as.shinystan function: 

sso <- as.shinystan(stanfit)
save(sso, file = "sso.rda")

You can then open "sso.rda" on any computer with shinystan installed. 

2) A shinystan object is automatically created from a stanfit object when you call launch_shinystan, but to save it you need to assign it to an object, e.g. 

sso <- launch_shinystan(stanfit)
save(sso, file = "sso.rda")

3) You can use the deploy_shinystan function to submit your model to RStudio's shinyapps (https://www.shinyapps.io) service and host it online. In the latest release of shinystan there's a bug in the deploy_shinystan function but it's already fixed on the develop branch of the shinystan github repository. 

Hope that helps, but let me know if that doesn't answer your question or if any of those options don't work.  

Jonah
